# Marky v1.10.0

The Soft Light update: a lighter, calmer Marky, and HTML documents beside your notes.

### Soft Light redesign

- **Soft Light everywhere.** Every screen, menu and dialog has been redrawn on one set of tokens: a quiet desk, an opaque page floating on it, one accent colour, and frosted floating surfaces. Borders and dividers are gone, and the only shadow sits under things that float.
- **A new Home.** Your vault opens on a Library of folders and notes shown as small previews of their content, with Recent and Pinned beside it, and your upcoming and recurring notes below.
- **Translucent window.** An optional setting in Appearance lets the desktop show softly blurred through the sidebar and title bar on macOS and Windows. Notes always stay on an opaque page.
- **Loading and empty states.** Anything that can take a moment shows that it is working, and an empty search, graph or list says what to do next instead of showing a blank panel.
- **No scrollbars.** Scrollbars stay hidden everywhere in the app. Scrolling still works with the trackpad, mouse wheel and keyboard.

### HTML documents

- **Open `.html` files beside your Markdown.** HTML documents in your vault show up in the sidebar, tabs, search and Home like any note, marked with an HTML tag.
- **Preview, edit and source.** Read a document as it renders, edit its text in place with a frosted formatting bar, or edit the raw source.
- **Sandboxed.** A document runs in a sandboxed frame. It can load only the images, stylesheets and scripts next to it in your vault, nothing else on your disk.

### Fixes

- **Round traffic lights on macOS.** The window buttons are now drawn by macOS itself. On recent macOS versions they were clipped flat on their left and right edges.
- **Inline math at the right size.** An equation inside a sentence no longer towers over the text around it.
- **Graph hints no longer overlap.** The "Drag to pan" hint steps aside while the graph is still arranging.

### Website

- [marky.amiralibg.xyz](https://marky.amiralibg.xyz) has been rebuilt around the Soft Light design, with fresh screenshots of the app.
